query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T20:05:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:15:00Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
| KEEP @timestamp, process.name, event.outcome, user.name, source.ip, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
